upstream.integration_rule: Do not copy or vendor upstream source into this repository. Temporary pinned checkout is allowed only for isolated research validation; production adoption requires separate license review.

objective: Test whether AlphaGen formulaic alpha mining can provide stable incremental cross-sectional ETF return ranking beyond simple momentum baselines.

alpha_mining.note: Stage1 uses AlphaGen RL expression generation and linear alpha pool, with least-squares pool optimization for bounded CPU cost. Backtrack 40 matches upstream maximum configured rolling window.
